name: Quantity and method
title: The quantity sets the method
description: Five physical quantities, each beside the real instrument that suits it and the principle it works by: light emitted (a desk lamp dimming and brightening over a light meter), its colour (a tunable source and a spectrometer), weight (calibration weights set down one by one on a precision balance, up to 2000.0 g), how fast it turns (a motor, reflective tape and an optical tachometer), how hot (a beaker on a hotplate, from ice water to a rolling boil, a type-K probe). Readings illustrative.
